source.name: Avoral
source.evidence: The Appendix 1 player progression determines which powers and resistances are available. The original Monster Manual explains that wing strikes work on land and feet supply the aerial claw strikes. source.catalogStatus: Same name appears in a non-player entry. This playable printing is a separate claim.

source.catalogStatus: Same name appears in a non-player entry. This playable printing is a separate claim.

entries.name: Ghaele
entries.aliases: Ghaele eladrin, separate from the 4e Eladrin claim

source.name: Ghaele
source.pageBasis: Printed and viewer page numbers coincide in this scan.
source.evidence: Ghaele 7 has 6 racial HD, caster level 7 for cleric casting and caster level 6 for lesser spell-like abilities. The class names five domains as additions to the normal spell list without granting domain slots, powers, or turn undead explicitly. The build uses its base and Wisdom bonus slots. The monster’s attack line clarifies that the 300-ft. light rays are ranged touch attacks. Treat the globe as lacking physical gear and natural armor while incorporeal. Armor Proficiency (Light) is a selected feat for the humanoid form’s chain shirt.
